title: Senate OKs postponement of barangay, SK polls
summary: Voting 13-5, the Senate has approved Senate Bill 2387, which reschedules the Barangay and Sangguniang Kabataan Elections November this year to the 2nd Monday of November 2028 and every 5 years…

blocks.text: Voting 13-5, the Senate has approved Senate Bill 2387, which reschedules the Barangay and Sangguniang Kabataan Elections November this year to the 2nd Monday of November 2028 and every 5 years afterwards as it provides for a 5 year term for those officials.
